title: Austere Sign
statementMd:
We are going to paint a sign but we can only afford stencils for $k$ letters. Update the text of the sign to use only $k$ unique letters without changing the lengths of any of the words, so that we can subtly fix the sign later.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/16c969845c7d5c8b3d095a6e7335c4d8dcc2c7fc.png)Illustration of Sample Input 1. You can do this!

## Input

- The first line of input contains the number of words, $n$ ($1 \le n \le 1000$), and the number of letters, $k$ ($1 \le k \le 26$).
- The second line of input contains $n$ words. Each word consists of between $1$ and $20$ lowercase latin letters.

## Output

Output a phrase using at most $k$ distinct letters, substituting as few from the original text as possible. If there are multiple possible answers, output any.
statementZhMd:
我们打算绘制一块招牌，但预算只够购买 k𝑘 种字母的模板。请修改招牌上的文字，使其只使用 k𝑘 种不同的字母，且不改变任何单词的长度，以便我们日后悄悄修正招牌。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/16c969845c7d5c8b3d095a6e7335c4d8dcc2c7fc.png)样例输入 1 的示意图。你能做到！

## 输入格式

- 输入的第一行包含单词数量 n𝑛 (1≤n≤10001≤𝑛≤1000)，以及字母种类数 k𝑘 (1≤k≤261≤𝑘≤26)。
- 输入的第二行包含 n𝑛 个单词。每个单词由 11 到 2020 个小写拉丁字母组成。

## 输出格式

输出一个最多使用 k𝑘 种不同字母的短语，使其相较于原文替换的字母数量尽可能少。如果有多个可行答案，输出任意一个。
